verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own docs reference built-in Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics, which the Insights Agent draws on for recommendations and conversational insights. On-Call Readiness Reports give a team-filtered view of each responder's readiness, a narrow slice of on-call health. No evidence documents MTTA/MTTR trend reporting or incident-load metrics directly, so support is partial. Missing for 10: documented MTTA/MTTR trend dashboards, incident-load/volume metrics, on-call burden or fatigue analytics beyond notification-rule readiness, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics
Every report provides a Team-filtered overview of each responder's on-call readiness status
On-Call Readiness Reports help organizations improve incident response quality by ensuring responders have optimal notification rule configurations
